title: Efficiency Cost of Learning Symmetric Noise in Pre-Additive Causal Dose Models
banked_reason: D0.5 kernel_substituted at oeq:primitive-frontier: primitive full-domain iff criterion and data-only attaining estimator remain open; independent validity gate confirmed terminal:laundering.
gap_reasons: The promised primitive necessary-and-sufficient full efficiency domain is still an OEQ: the proved tail test is expressly only for the smooth-score completion and supplies at most a necessary condition for the full domain, so the headline constructive frontier is not delivered.
No data-only attaining estimator is established on the regular region: the required general-law pilot rate, inverse stability, fitted-gradient convergence, and nonlinear remainder are all left open.

This is a conditional cross-fit reduction whose two decisive training-output hypotheses are not proved for the advertised pilot, so it cannot serve as the Stat headline efficiency/coverage deliverable.
proof_attempt_summary: Four D0 solve rounds established score/tangent/population-variance results but did not close the all-path target-differentiability frontier or construct a data-only efficient estimator. The censored-spline route failed at the tail-stable likelihood wall; the finite tournament left a nonvanishing general-law transfer term and unresolved fitted-gradient/remainder bounds. Discovery stopped at D0.5 kernel_substituted; no formalization or Lean proof was attempted.
tldr: The identified untruncated causal contrast has an exact smooth-score tail test: \(\alpha<1/4\), or \(\alpha=1/4\) with \(c>\max\{-b,b+d-1/2\}\). Both critical equality faces have infinite smooth-score derivative cost. Full and calibrated tangent exhaustion includes moving bounded response supports. At doses already in \(\mathcal D_{\mathrm{pd}}(g,f)\), both canonical gradients equal their score-core solves. The full cost of learning symmetric noise is exactly the squared calibrated contrast-load discrepancy plus a nonnegative profiled response adjustment; variance equality, a zero discrepancy and compatibility with every symmetric noise direction are equivalent. Population full-variance certification and observable-rank clipping are available. All-path target differentiability on the candidate primitive region and general-law accuracy of the proposed learner remain unresolved; efficient cross-fitting is conditional on its two training-output properties.
gap: Engression recovers monotone structural responses from conditional distributions. Compact transformation inference and regular original-response means are also established. These results do not, in their inspected theorem scopes, classify full-likelihood regularity of the specified untruncated causal contrast outside assigned support with both structural functions unknown.
fill: The explicit response construction integrates the exponential of the quadratic log slope once. A primitive tail lemma establishes finite response and causal-contrast moments before the information analysis. The primitive joint score is reduced through Uniform shifts and symmetry. Whole-line separation and legal tangent exhaustion support a constructive canonical system, while tail analysis determines its exact domain. A buffered joint likelihood pilot and certified correction must turn that domain into feasible efficient inference from the fixed smoothness envelopes. A sensitivity proposition states the remaining translation convention, the Gaussian-envelope location anchor, the lost asymmetric gap, and the local centering condition for skew departures.
